editorial:
Get ready to step into the magical land of Oz before the big movie even hits theaters. You get to follow Angela Bishop as she hangs out with the stars of the show, giving you an inside look at how this massive world was built. It feels like you are right there with the cast, listening to them share secrets and funny stories from the set. The whole vibe is super upbeat and exciting, making you feel the hype for the main story of Elphaba and Glinda. It is less of a formal documentary and more like a fun backstage pass that lets you see the human side of the actors.

What really works here is how the cast lets their guards down and actually spills some tea about the production. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though it is a short clip rather than a full film. If you love musicals or just want to see the amazing costumes up close, you have to check this out.
endingExplained: The sneak peek wraps up by building a huge amount of excitement for the November 20 release. It ends with a final montage of breathtaking shots from the movie, showing the scale of the Emerald City. The cast gives a final wave and a tease about the emotional journey you will go through. It leaves you on a cliffhanger, making it clear that the friendship between the two leads is the real heart of the story.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Broadway and the world of Oz.
